stem: In paragraphs 7 and 8, what is the most likely reason the author contrasts food forests with community gardens?

options.label: F
options.text: To reveal problems caused by the amount of time it takes for community gardens to produce crops

options.label: G
options.text: To give reasons why food forests include more perennials than community gardens

options.label: H
options.text: To note objections to charging residents for use of plots in community gardens

options.label: J
options.text: To highlight distinctions in costs, labor, and plants between food forests and community gardens
